'''Allen Varney''' reviewed Star Wars CCG for ''[[The Duelist]]''. His Premiere review is [[A Forced Effort (The Duelist)]]. He also wrote Duelist game-news columns that named SWCCG expansions.<ref name="duelist9" /><ref name="wp-swccg" />
